sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B - Jetson AI Lab
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B is Qwen's dense, open-weight vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. It brings the strongest generation of Qwen open models to a deployment-friendly size, with better planning and stronger handling of tool and environment feedback for more reliable multi-step task completion.
